brief: The canvas displays a structured grid, representing the organization of all known elements. Each element occupies a distinct box containing a symbol, atomic number, and general information. The overall layout is color-coded and highly organized, maintaining the familiar arrangement of groups and periods. When a viewer clicks on any individual element, the box highlights, and supplementary information or a visual detail about that specific element appears or expands within the structure. The grid remains the central, unchanging focal point, but its elements respond directly to user interaction.

statement: This sketch presents an interactive visualization of the periodic table of elements. It displays a structured grid where each element is represented by a distinct box containing its symbol, atomic number, and name, arranged according to standard chemical groupings and periods. When a viewer clicks on any element, that specific box becomes highlighted and expands to show detailed information about that element in a side panel. The design maintains the familiar organizational structure of the periodic table while enabling direct user interaction to explore individual elements. The visualization uses a clean, color-coded approach that makes both the overall structure and individual details immediately accessible.
